{"code": "from IPython.display import display

# Deduplicate: keep only the highest sample_seq for each patient
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending) to ensure highest sample_seq is kept
df_dedup = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates('patient_id', keep='first')

# Confirm deduplication worked
final_n_patients = len(df_dedup)
print(f'Final number of unique patients after deduplication: {final_n_patients}')

# Check that we kept the correct rows: verify that all patients with sample_seq > 1 now appear only once
retest_patients = df_dedup[df_dedup['patient_id'].isin(df[df['sample_seq'] > 1]['patient_id'])]
print(f'Number of patients that were re-tested (now appearing once): {len(retest_patients)}')

# Verify no duplicates remain
df_dedup.duplicated('patient_id').sum()"}
